steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: That should've got rid of him...
The girl takes a cautious peek, glancing back at the street outside the alley.
Seeing the computer-headed guy in the big coat runs straight into the next alley, the girl finally breathes a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Gone finally. How did he manage to follow me in here... He'd scared me enough outside already.
Nino frowns and thinks for a while in vain. Finally, she gives up.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ahhhh... Forget it! I only had time to leave a message before running out of the phone booth when that guy popped up.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I need to find a way to get to Chief and Eleven quickly!
But how do I sneak into the TV station in the middle of the night? And what if I'm stuck at the entrance and run into that computer head again?!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ah... If only I'd had ground-drilling or wall-climbing superpowers in this strange world... Or perhaps I could squeeze myself into the TV and wriggle my way into the TV station through the cables!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Sigh, in my dreams. I must think of something feasible...
What if... it is feasible?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Who is it?!
Not far away, in a half-closed internet cafe, one of the computers has lit up faintly. A shadow hovers above the screen, speaking in an eerie voice.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Like you've said... this is a strange world... Why not give it a try?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Give it a try...?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But... there's nothing here?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: All you've got here are several hundred old computers. I'd be better off streaming myself digging up some antiques from the Rust.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Ah, what a letdown, I'm off... I still have to stream the game I didn't finish yesterday.
With that, the girl puts her hands behind her head and makes for the exit. But before leaving, she glimpses surreptitiously at the computer screen where the shadow is.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: "If the world could be changed by dreaming..."

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Huh? What are you saying?

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: "Then I would sleep in this dream and never wake up, until the joyous world of my imagination has been created."
As if murmuring to itself, the shadow moves from one computer to another. Every time it touches a screen, the computer miraculously turns on and displays an image.
Images of all kinds of video games crop up one after another on the computer screens. Some the girl can name, and many more she's only heard of on DisMyth.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: So, now... do you want to give it a try?

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: You just do what you do all the time, only in a different environment~ Want to... give it a shot? Maybe you can catch up with your companions as you said?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Al-alright... I get to experience everything here right?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hold on... Can I take a picture?
Acting calm, the girl swallows and takes out her phone. She turns around and asks the shadow.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Certainly.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Haha, great! I've finally got a chance to play with these antiques. I'm so gonna show off to my fans when I get back...
But she notices something.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Eh? There's no game controller or disc drive, so how am I supposed to...

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Of course, not here.
As the shadow turns on the last computer, the entire space is enveloped in dazzling white light. The girl's figure gradually blurs, as if she is about to fuse with this space.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: What kind of voice will you find me...? Or rather... what kind of voice do you want to hear?
